Goodhue County Brand
More Than A Logo
Our reputation, services, experiences, marketing, and communications all play a role in actively shaping our philosophy. Goodhue County always has and always will strive to meet our mission statement: “To effectively promote the safety, health, and well-being of our residents.”

About Goodhue County
Goodhue County is a naturally gorgeous place with dozens of parks, welcoming communities, and a thriving business community. Our county seat is established in Red Wing, MN but our County has nine other cities within our borders.
